fireball_stoking: An iron fire poker stirring a heap of glowing red embers; a tall flame leaps up from the embers.
fireball_searing_breath: Seen from above: a small fireball at the center surrounded by a wide expanding ring of fire, with short sparks flying outward.
fireball_velocity: A fireball rushing to the right, with three long pale speed lines trailing behind it.
fireball_ardor: A fireball with a sharp four-pointed white star glint on its upper right, the sparkle of a critical hit.
fireball_forked_tongue: Two fireballs splitting apart in a V shape from a single point on the left, each with a fiery tail.
fireball_piercing: A fireball that has punched straight through a round wooden shield and comes out the other side, splinters flying.
fireball_frost: A fireball turned completely into blue ice: a frozen blue orb bristling with sharp ice crystals.
fireball_kindling: A burning matchstick held diagonally, its head bursting into a small flame, little sparks around it.
fireball_fragmentation: A fireball bursting into six small fireballs flying outward in a star pattern.
fireball_chain_reaction: A white skull exploding inside a burst of orange fire.
fireball_meteor: A huge flaming rock meteor plunging diagonally from the top right corner, with a long fire tail.
fireball_dense_core: A small white-hot glowing sphere squeezed by four grey iron spikes pointing at it from the corners.
fireball_updraft: A fireball rising upward, carried by a pale swirling whirlwind beneath it.
fireball_overheat: A glass thermometer whose red liquid is boiling over the top, with heat waves.
fireball_fed_fire: A campfire of crossed logs with tall flames, and a fireball rising out of the flames.
fireball_meteor_shower: Four small flaming meteors falling diagonally in parallel, like rain.
fireball_free_fall: A flaming meteor plunging straight down toward the ground, with vertical speed lines on both sides.
fireball_deep_frost: A large sharp blue snowflake made of ice crystals.
fireball_cascade: One fireball splitting into three smaller fireballs, each splitting again into even tinier fireballs, like branches.
fireball_powder_keg: A wooden gunpowder barrel with iron bands and a lit fuse sparking on top.
fireball_convergence: Three fire trails coming from the left that converge on one bright point on the right.
fireball_wide_blast: A wide flat fire explosion spreading along the ground in a horizontal wave of flames.
fireball_girth: A giant swollen fireball next to a tiny fireball, showing how much it grew.
